meta.title: FirstDev
meta.description: Hiring where every skill is verified: CV, GitHub repos and assessments.

landing.tagline: Skills you can verify, not just claim.
landing.subtitle: FirstDev checks a developer's CV against real code and short assessments, so recruiters see what is proven and what is only written down.
landing.demoNote: A private demo sandbox is created just for you and deleted after 24 hours. No sign-up needed.
landing.demoError: Could not start the demo. Please try again.
landing.demoLimit: Demo limit reached for today. Please try again tomorrow.

how.title: How verification works
how.step1Body: The CV is parsed into skills and experience. These start as claims, shown in grey.
how.step2Body: Repositories are analysed for languages, tests, CI and dependencies. Skills backed by real code turn amber.
how.step3Body: Short timed assessments confirm a skill. A score of 70% or more earns a verified badge.
